reviews.title: My best upgrade purchase yet
reviews.comment:
I've needed to upgrade my ram for quite a while, I was running 2 8GB sticks. It was hard to play some of my favorite games, especially Minecraft or Project Zomboid without it eating up most of my ram. I did some research to see what sticks were compatible with my pc on pcpartpicker and these were the cheapest, but the greatest upgrade I can get so far without having to cough up a lot of money. I saved up and got these 2 sticks for a total of 32 GB, it has been my best purchase yet.
Installing these sticks was easy and fit in my pc without any issues. They came packed in a nice little box as well! After installing and turning on my pc, I noticed they had an rgb feature, which I didn't realize in the title of the product, but it's a bonus for me since my entire pc is rainbow rgb.
Overall, these sticks are great, they fit the aesthetics of my pc set-up, is compatible with my other parts, offers more memory capacity, and has made my gaming performance so much better.
reviews.author: Madison Anders

reviews.title: Works Great!
reviews.comment: Was able to get the rated 4000mhz with the rated CL18 timings by simply enabling one of the A-XMP profiles in BIOS. Motherboard is an MSI Pro b550m VC WiFi with a Ryzen 5700x CPU. Have had it installed for about 1 week now with no stability issues. This particular model number was not on my MB QVL list but I saw a few others with the same cpu and the same b550m chipset say it was compatible at the rated speed so I decided to get it. Glad I did because it was a decent value. Easy to install, took the old out and put the new in and my pc recognized it instantly on the first boot. Performance has been great, really snappy and quick. Plus jumping from 16gb to 32gb of ram I have a lot more headroom now.
reviews.author: Taylor Legrand

reviews.title: Good DDR4 memory
reviews.comment: Fast, easy to install, and very tolerant to speed increases. Memory capacity is great for gaming and office work. Fit is perfect and will extend the life of your DDR4 rig. Running stable on the XMP profile.
reviews.author: E+T

reviews.title: G.Skill Trident 4000
reviews.comment: These memory sticks work really well after I've installed both of them, so far no major issues on boot and while my PC is running, and they were fairly easy to install. Plus in a specific  rgb software I have they're supported and each stick can be individually customized. If you want high speeds at a affordable price I recommend these sticks.
reviews.author: Frank Staples
